body:
True but you use Typescript 2.0.
That one with Typescript 2.2.1 is broken: http://plnkr.co/edit/iDsenqxhVXsMFZK8BFjI?p=preview
Yeah I don't see what the issue is here. The base classes constructor is never being called so why would your service ever be defined?

As reported here: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/11606#issuecomment-262315256, Angular Team has implemented this feature and it should work as we expected (an as before Typescript 2.1 was).
@GianlucaMaggio Oh my mistake, sorry I had not seen that, definitely looks like an issue to me then

@ebrehault see https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/14366#issuecomment-289550051
angular is not fully compatible with ts 2.2.x+
I tried also with 2.1.x but the problem still exists.

Yeah, doesn't work with 2.1.1 either http://plnkr.co/edit/LdAbafO54zcW7TFfkpD3?p=preview
2.0.10 is the only working version

Yes, but we cannot use 2.0.10 with Angular 4 due to compatibility issues like`: Typescript: error node_modules/@angular/common/src/platform_id.d.ts(8,42): error TS1039: Initializers are not allowed in ambient contexts.` 

So we are blocked now! Why none recognize it as a **regression**?

@DzmitryShylovich, I'm sorry, we have hundreds of components! We are not "playing" with Angular, we are building a platform on it and this **regression** is important for us!  
We counted a lot on this feature, please fix it @tbosch.
@GianlucaMaggio This is with JIT, right? AOT should work fine...
